card.name: Words just before crush, cut, or chop
card.fires_on: Small words like "be", "not", "and" or a comma right before a verb of cutting, crushing or mincing. Seen in tablet instructions ("must not be crushed") and in recipe ingredient lists ("minced", "diced").

modes.label: Tablet handling
modes.description: "be" or "not" before crushed, split, broken, or chewed in tablet swallowing instructions.
modes.example: Tablets should not<< be>> crushed, cut, or chewed;

modes.label: Recipe prep
modes.description: "and" or a comma before minced or diced in an ingredient list.
modes.example: 4 anchovy fillets, rinsed<< and>> minced 1 tablespoon tomato paste 1
